meaning: Reviewed season-bounded exceptions to the provider team-ID bindings. Each entry assigns a provider team ID to a different catalog team for the inclusive season starting years given.

overrides.note: ESPN's team 3 runs from the 1988-2002 Charlotte Hornets through today's Pelicans. The NBA's record, followed by Basketball Reference, places 1988-2002 with today's Charlotte franchise and starts New Orleans in 2002-03.
